Backend Engineer

Mid Full-time based in Berlin, Germany. We're looking for someone who has spent years shipping payment APIs in Python and Go, with solid PostgreSQL modeling and Redis for hot paths. Kafka experience for event-driven settlement is expected. Familiarity with Kubernetes and Terraform is welcome but not required. You will own services end to end with our platform team.
